{{Quote|A friend of mine had a prisoner escape because he wasn't keeping a close eye on the grubber; he figured the magnaharness would hold him, so why waste the effort?|Lloco, posting on the Magnaharness on Gundark's Datalog|<ref name="GFTPG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
The [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]] '''MCI-200''' [[magnaharness]] was a restraining device that used the micro [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic field]] technology of the [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]], but to a greater extent: It tied up a person's neck and trunk, preventing the prey from escaping. The MCI-200 was used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] such as [[Tyrn Jiton]]. It could be bought through the illegal [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], where [[Lloco]] posted about its imperfections.

==Description==
The MCI-200 [[magnaharness]] was used to restrain the movements of a victim. It was attached to the person's collar and thorax, but it also included optional clips to tie up arms, hands, upper part of the legs, lower part of the legs and feet. The harness used the same micro [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic fields]] present in [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]] to keep the clips locked.<ref name="GG10" />

==History==
The MCI-200 was developed by [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]] and was available for 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GG10" /> It could be bought through the illegal [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]. A person self-identified as [[Lloco]] posted that a friend of his restrained a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] with a MCI-200 and failed to watch him; but the prisoner had a hidden [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and could call for help. Due to this, Lloco suggested that users of MCI-200 should not relax completely, as the item was not perfect.<ref name="GFTPG" />

During the times of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the MCI-200 was used by several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], including [[Tyrn Jiton]].<ref name="GG10" /> By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Jiton had stopped using it.<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The MCI-200 was first described in ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' ([[1994]]), and then all the text describing it was repeated in ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' ([[1997]]), with two differences: ''Gundark's Fantastic Technology'' added an anecdote told by Lloco, and misspelled "neck" as "next". Both sources describe the magnaharness as using the technology of the MagnaCuffs, which is understood as the restraining technology. The MagnaCuffs are also described as using a fingerprint identification system to replace a key,<ref name="GG10" /> but sources do not detail whether the magnaharness reproduce this or not.
